text:
Jorge R.: FYI we got an invoice from NimbusEdge (INV-NE-0312) for $23,640 but PDF shows no PO and description is "Compute credits + burst" which is vague. Vendor says due in 10 days. Can procurement confirm PO or should we request reissue?
Invoices Bot: New invoice: INV-NE-0312 uploaded by NimbusEdge  amount $23,640  status: unmatched. Link: https://accounting.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-NE-0312
Priya S.: I think this maps to contract PO-79011 (SRE infra pool) but the committed amount there was $20k. Does the invoice include overage lines? @Procurement Team?
Procurement Team: Confirmed PO-79011 exists but it's for a fixed credit block. Vendor may have billed actual usage beyond commitment. We need vendor to either: 1) split invoice to reference PO-79011 + new PO for overage, or 2) reissue with PO noted and provide explanation lines.
Len (Vendor Ops - NimbusEdge): Hi everyone  sorry for the confusion. Invoice INV-NE-0312 was auto-generated by our billing engine and it omitted the PO field when usage exceeds the committed bucket. We can reissue as INV-NE-0312-R1 with PO-79011 annotated for the committed portion and a separate line for the overage. Which option helps your AP team?
Kaitlyn (AP): We prefer a single PDF with PO on header and clear line items showing PO-applied amount and overage, plus a breakdown that maps to GL codes. Otherwise AP holds payment for manual matching.
Jorge R.: Agreed. Also we need a statement about why overage occurred (date ranges, usage spike) for cost owner.
Priya S.: I'll accept the charge but please tag cost center: eng-sre and GL: 5101-INF-OPS.
CFO Bot: Reminder: invoices >$20k require finance lead review. Routing will go to @Anika if amount stays >20k after PO allocation.
Procurement Team: We'll ask NimbusEdge for INV-NE-0312-R1 with PO-79011 on header + overage broken out. If vendor can't split, Procurement will create a supplemental PO-79011-S1 to cover the delta and reference both POs on the invoice.
Len (Vendor Ops - NimbusEdge): Understood. We'll reissue by EOD with line-item breakdown and note PO-79011. If you want a supplemental PO code added on the PDF we can include both PO numbers.
Kaitlyn (AP): Please also include remittance instructions and bank reference (we got an older SWIFT on file).
Jorge R.: Thanks. I'll mark cost owner approved pending the reissued invoice and GL mapping.
Invoices Bot: Invoice INV-NE-0312-R1 uploaded  amount $23,640  status: pending match. Link: https://accounting.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-NE-0312-R1
Priya S.: Received the reissue. Looks good; PO-79011 applied for $20k, overage $3,640 flagged. I approve routing to Anika for finance lead review.
CFO Bot: Routing to @Anika for review (trigger: invoice >20k).
Kaitlyn (AP): I'll match once Anika signs off and schedule payment for the next AP run.
Len (Vendor Ops - NimbusEdge): Payment terms unchanged 30 days. Thanks for working quickly.
Jorge R.: Closing loop: create vendor ticket: "NimbusEdge invoice omitted PO when usage > committed; reissued INV-NE-0312-R1; PO-79011 applied $20k; overage $3,640; charge GL 5101-INF-OPS; routed to Anika."
